native.ff_profile: Reviewed two-wire voltage-mode H1 baseline proposal. Optical/media extensions require their own physical evidence; HSE Ethernet is a different transport.
native.ff_configuration_source: Required matched specification/firmware/network configuration reference, unknown.
native.ff_cff_source: Required matched device CFF capability file/version, unknown. Capacity, timer and block constraints are not universal defaults.
native.ff_schedule_source: Required actual LAS/VCR/block execution/communication schedule evidence, unknown. Schedule feasibility is not implied by bitrate.
native.ff_layout: Qualified FMS/FAS/data-transfer diagram layout. Control PDUs and fragmented logical domains need their own definition.
native.ff_pdu: Actual link PDU, unknown. Native control traffic is not an FMS data-transfer packet.
native.ff_fms_pci_bytes: Four-octet FMS PCI proposal only for reviewed FMS DT layout.
native.ff_fas_pci_bytes: One-octet FAS PCI proposal only for reviewed FMS DT layout.
native.ff_dl_sdu_bytes: Actual data-link SDU, equals FMS encoded payload plus FMS/FAS PCI in reviewed DT layout. Priority ceiling applies to DLSDU, not payload.
native.ff_dl_pci_bytes: Actual data-link PCI, unknown; reviewed DT diagram range5..15 octets. Not a universal overhead8.
native.ff_fcs_bytes: Two-octet frame-check sequence baseline proposal. A declared size does not recompute or verify integrity.
native.ff_ph_sdu_bytes: Actual complete DL PDU/physical SDU, including DL PCI/SDU/FCS. Reviewed FMS diagram range8..273; excludes physical delimiters/preamble.
native.ff_preamble_bytes: Baseline one-octet preamble proposal; actual repeaters may require extension. Lower baseline does not prove physical synchronization.
native.ff_start_bytes: One-octet-equivalent physical start delimiter proposal, includes non-data symbols; not an Ethernet preamble.
native.ff_end_bytes: One-octet-equivalent physical end delimiter proposal; not an Ethernet interframe gap.
native.ff_wire_octets: Actual physical telegram sum including preamble/start/end. Excludes idle/response/token exchanges and block execution; not whole transaction latency.
native.ff_priority: Actual native DLL urgency, unknown. Qualified DLSDU ceilings64/128/256 bytes respectively; no CAN ID or Ethernet PCP conversion.
native.ff_vcr: Actual VCR model. Buffered scheduled publication differs from queued client/server or source/sink token traffic.
native.ff_access: Actual native access mechanism. CD scheduled publication; PT unscheduled token passing. Not generic FIFO arbitration.
native.ff_buffering: Actual VCR storage semantics; buffered publisher/subscriber is not a queue. Queue capacity remains actual CFF configuration.
native.ff_device_class: Actual device class, unknown. BASIC cannot become LAS; link master and bridge have capability, not automatic active status.
native.ff_las_active: Actual LAS active state, unknown. Exactly one active LAS per link requires topology/runtime evidence; not auto true.
native.ff_las_owner: Actual LAS node identity, unknown. LAS service address4 differs from configured physical node address.
native.ff_las_service_address: Reserved LAS service address4 baseline; does not allocate node address4 to an ordinary device.
native.ff_node_address: Actual8-bit node address, unknown. Operational range16..247 differs from cleared248..251 and temporary252..255; LM/BASIC allocation uses actual FUN/NUN.
native.ff_address_state: Actual address allocation category, unknown. A random commissioning address is not a persisted operational default.
native.ff_fun: Actual boundary of link-master address pool, unknown. Not hard-coded16 or vendor sample20.
native.ff_nun: Actual unused address count, unknown. BASIC start=FUN+NUN; actual address availability must be checked.
native.ff_link_address: Actual logical link16-bit identifier, unknown; may be omitted within a link, needed across bridge.
native.ff_selector: Actual8-bit selector, unknown. DLCEP and DLSAP reserved allocation depends on VCR and device CFF, not just scalar range.
native.ff_vcr_index: Actual device-local VCR index, unknown; device-specific capacity and supported index allocation require CFF.
native.ff_pd_tag: Actual physical-device readable tag, unknown. Tag identity differs from numeric network address.
native.ff_sm_state: Actual system-management state, unknown. SM_OPERATIONAL is not inferred from address or selected profile.
native.ff_macrocycle_us: Actual configured communication/block macrocycle microseconds, unknown. No universal100ms CAN/application-cycle default.
native.ff_scheduled_us: Actual total scheduled communication occupied window microseconds. Complete CD/DT/response gaps and other scheduled traffic must be included by schedule source.
native.ff_unscheduled_us: Actual available unscheduled budget microseconds, unknown; cannot be treated as zero merely because schedule is absent.
native.ff_maintenance_us: Actual maintenance/synchronization/probing and remaining reserved macrocycle budget microseconds. Budget partition must sum to declared macrocycle.
native.ff_publish_offset_us: Actual publication offset within macrocycle microseconds, unknown; not block execution completion proof.
native.ff_exchange_bound_us: Actual bounded complete scheduled transaction duration microseconds including CD/DT/gaps/response. Wire telegram duration alone is insufficient.
native.ff_token_hold_us: Actual granted PT token holding interval microseconds, unknown. Different from scheduled DT and NIS request timeout.
native.ff_response_bound_us: Actual matched CFF/device response bound normalized to microseconds, unknown. Native timer units require source conversion; no sample-device value copied.
native.ff_cable_type: Source-recommended Type A shielded twisted-pair baseline proposal. B/C/D are source reference wiring profiles, not automatically accepted installation designs.
native.ff_trunk_m: Actual trunk length, unknown. Total segment includes all spurs; nominal1900m Type A is an upper reference limit, not a default length.
native.ff_spurs_total_m: Actual summed spur lengths, unknown. Per-spur/device-count/reference limits and IS constraints require actual topology source.
native.ff_segment_total_m: Actual trunk plus summed spurs. Qualified reference limits A1900/B1200/C400/D200m; DEVICE_SPECIFIC requires own verified bounds.
native.ff_terminators: Baseline two end terminators proposal, not evidence that wiring has two. Different media require their own realization.
native.ff_termination_ohm: Nominal100ohm end termination proposal. Actual impedance/tolerance and capacitive coupling require source.
native.ff_terminal_v: Actual received device voltage, unknown. Reviewed voltage-mode envelope9..32V does not certify selected device/IS barrier operating limits.
native.ff_supply_ma: Actual available power-conditioner/barrier current budget, unknown. Not inferred from32-node illustration.
native.ff_devices_ma: Actual total device current including limits/reserves, unknown; must fit available current. Individual voltage drops still require evidence.
native.ff_is_required: Actual intrinsic-safety requirement, unknown. It does not claim SIL/safety communication or explosion protection.
native.ff_is_source: Actual matched intrinsic-safety barrier/device/cable certificate and entity/FISCO design evidence, unknown; required when IS selected.
native.bitrate: Fixed nominal31250 bit/s H1 baseline, not configurable CAN rate or100M HSE link.
native.payload_bytes: Actual FMS encoded data0..251 integer octets in qualified DT layout; no8-byte proposal. Full logical domain may require segmentation; lower-frame and priority limits separate.

removed.qos_priority: Native URGENT/NORMAL/TIME_AVAILABLE and SDU limits replace unrelated default3.
removed.reserved_bandwidth_percent: Actual LAS schedule/time partitions replace generic reservation0.
removed.sync_method: Native LS/application-time synchronization differs from generic NONE/NTP/PTP.
removed.retransmission_enabled: VCR flow control, event acknowledgments and token scheduling are distinct; no universal retry switch.
removed.retransmission_delay_ms: No universal H1 packet retry delay0ms.
removed.gateway_maximum_throughput: No universal100M H1 gateway capacity; HSE is a separate transport.
removed.queue_policy: Native VCR BUFFERED/QUEUED declaration replaces generic FIFO policy, not a capacity executor.
removed.queue_size: Actual VCR queue resources depend on matched CFF, no fabricated256-entry default.
